knowledge_gaps: Withholding an interaction only when constructing a diagnostic prefix does not make it unseen during model training. These probes measure training-history behavior, not generalization; user bootstrap intervals do not remove this bias.

Recent versus older interaction removal changes both content and positional distances. The protocol needs explicit removal sizes, eligible positions, truncation rules and controls before attributing differences to recency dependence.
Reproducibility requires user/prefix sample sizes, negative-sampling exclusions, repeat-target handling, tie rules, bootstrap settings, numerical tolerances and a diagnostic GPU-time cap.

The documented ModelView does not expose mask provenance, attention configuration or checkpoint-loading hooks. Structural checks need explicit instrumentation and independently specified expected outcomes; otherwise they may merely verify the probe's own implementation.

The adapter is a reasonable prerequisite, but no experiment connects its findings to improved macro validation HR@10. Originality 4 is plausible; potential 8 is speculative, and difficulty 4 likely understates integration work. The required full-catalog recommendations for five training users per category also need an explicit place in the workflow.

follow_up_queries.reason: Clarify what training-prefix diagnostics can establish and prevent memorization from being interpreted as generalization.
follow_up_queries.query: In BERT4Rec sequential recommendation, how should prefix-based diagnostics be interpreted when the withheld target interaction was included in model training? Find protocols distinguishing reconstruction, memorization and next-item generalization, including repeated-item targets and sampled-negative exclusions, without changing a fixed benchmark split.

follow_up_queries.reason: Resolve positional confounding and define reproducible history interventions.
follow_up_queries.query: For BERT4Rec with left-padded histories, learned positional embeddings and appended-mask inference, how can recent-versus-older interaction removal experiments distinguish content dependence from changes in sequence length and position? Find controlled deletion, replacement or position-preserving protocols and their limitations.

follow_up_queries.reason: Establish implementable integrity checks and estimate their integration cost.
follow_up_queries.query: What instrumentation and regression tests verify BERT4Rec masked-target provenance, bidirectional attention, padding exclusion, final-mask readout and checkpoint-reloaded prediction parity? Include BERT-style unchanged-token masking cases, repeated item IDs, independent positive controls and floating-point tolerance guidance.
